utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Mina. Keep me posted once the plan’s firmed up, and I can help with parking or tool drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam. I’ll greet folks first and then sort the tools as they come in, and I’ll let you know if parking starts getting tight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Vik. I’m still a bit worried about keeping the parking and tool drop-off clear, but if the signs are up before Saturday, that should make things much easier.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, the signs should take care of most of that. I’ll make sure folks know to keep parking open and use the porch for tool drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ll keep everyone posted once the plan is firmed up, and any help with parking or tool drop-off would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, I’ll keep an ear out and help with parking or tool drop-off if I can. Just let me know when the details settle down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Rosa. I’ll keep Sunday at the community center in mind and wait for your role details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik. I’m lining up the roles now and I’ll send the details shortly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sort the tools first, then greet folks as they come up. That way you’re ready when things get busy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. I’ll sort the tools first, then greet folks as they come up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Vik. Keep me posted, and I’ll be ready to help with parking or tool drop-off once the plan is set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Uli. I’ll send the updated plan once I’ve got the Sunday details sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that should keep people from circling around. I’m still a bit worried we’re light on helpers, so I’m glad you’re lining up more before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia. I’ve moved it to Sunday at the community center, and I’m lining up the helper roles now so we’re not short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out, and I’ll ask around for anyone else who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Oren. Keep me posted once the plan’s firmed up, and I can help with parking or tool drop-off.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
